datasets: BeIR (FiQA, SciFact, BioASQ, TREC-COVID, CQADupStack, Robust04)

changes_made.explanation: Consolidated duplicate task entry, normalized model names (T5 instead of T5 encoder-decoder, MiniLM instead of cross-encoder), added BeIR as a consolidated dataset reference.
Added nDCG@10 which is the primary automatic metric used throughout the paper to evaluate retrieval performance.

Removed all items as they relate to the pseudo-labeling training process, not LLM-based evaluation of generated outputs. The cross-encoder is used for scoring during training, not as a judge of generated queries.
No human evaluation was conducted in this paper - all evaluation is automatic using nDCG@10.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on unsupervised domain adaptation for dense retrieval using query generation as a means to create training data. The NLG aspect (query generation) is part of the training methodology, not the main evaluation focus. The primary evaluation uses automatic retrieval metrics (nDCG@10) rather than directly evaluating the quality of generated queries.
